title: Confined sessions cannot read the host user's personal credentials
description: With a fixture HOME holding an SSH key, a gh token, .git-credentials, .netrc, Docker and AWS credentials, a second install's directory, another agent account home and declared extra mask paths, a worker and a review session under real bubblewrap read none of them while the worker's own token, runtime login, sync, test command and complete still work; the master session reads only its own install directory and token.

steps.name: host credentials masked from confined sessions
